text.en: Dog owners praise trainer Andrea and her team for their constructive guidance, patience, and prompt follow-up on questions. Clients appreciate that she adapts training methods to each dog rather than forcing a rigid approach, creating a supportive learning environment for both puppies and their handlers.

Reviewers report major behavioral improvements, including reduced leash reactivity, stopped demand nipping, and reliable crate training. Owners note that consistent practice with group sessions transformed reactive or anxious pets into calm, well-mannered companions during neighborhood walks.

Clients emphasize that the training focuses on building confidence and establishing clear boundaries through positive reinforcement. Dogs that previously struggled with anxiety or excitement learned to settle calmly, with owners noting that their pets genuinely enjoy attending group practice classes.

q.en: What training methods are used at The Job of Calm?

a.en: Training emphasizes positive reinforcement, clear communication, and adaptable techniques tailored to each dog.
Yes, clients regularly attend group training sessions to reinforce leash manners and socialization skills.

q.en: Can the trainer assist with puppy behavioral issues?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report significant success with boundary setting, crate training, recall, and managing nipping in adolescent dogs.
